51563655.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant His-tagged mouse PD-L1 (1 to 238 residues) expressed in HEK293 cells assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.SPR Analysis: Unless otherwise specified, all proteins used in the tests were purchased from Sino Biological Biotech, Inc.: human PD-L1 (catalog number: 10084-HNAH), murine PD-L1 (catalog number: S0010-M08H). SPR assay was performed using PlexArray HT. Briefly, the concentration of h/mPD-L1 was diluted to 0.5 mg/mL with ultrapure water and was immobilized on a bare gold-plated PlexArray nanocapture sensor chip via an amide bond. Then, LP23 (0.1, 0.5, 1, 5, 10, 20 μM) was injected into the flow cell (30 μL) by a nonpulsatile piston pump.
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Figure 3. Binding affinity of LP23 and PD-L1 protein determined by the SPR assay. Real-time interaction curve between LP23 and human PD-L1 (A), and murine PD-L1 (B).

sensor_chip.type: bare gold-plated PlexArray nanocapture sensor chip
